suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(readxl)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(dplyr)
})
# Read expression CSV (two-row header: #group, then sample names)
expr_raw <- read.csv("inputs/expression-matrix-444444444444.csv",
                     header = FALSE,
                     skip = 1,           # skip the "#group,group1,..." row
                     check.names = FALSE)
sample_names <- as.character(expr_raw[1, -1])
expr_df <- expr_raw[-1, ]
colnames(expr_df) <- c("id", sample_names)
# Coerce all sample columns to numeric
expr_df[, -1] <- lapply(expr_df[, -1], as.numeric)
# Deduplicate by id (some rows were repeated) using mean per gene
expr_df <- expr_df %>%
  group_by(id) %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)), .groups = "drop")
cat("Unique genes after dedup:", nrow(expr_df), "\n")
# Read differential analysis from Excel
diff_res <- read_excel("inputs/differential-results-333333333333.xlsx", sheet = "Sheet 1")
cat("Differential rows:", nrow(diff_res), "\n")
# Merge: average expression + diff stats
merged <- diff_res %>%
  inner_join(expr_df, by = "id") %>%
  mutate(
    avg_expr = rowMeans(across(-c(id, log2FoldChange, pvalue)), na.rm = TRUE),
    neg_log10_p = -log10(pvalue)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(pvalue), !is.na(log2FoldChange))
cat("Merged rows:", nrow(merged), "\n")
cat("Range log2FC:", range(merged$log2FoldChange, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("Range -log10(p):", range(merged$neg_log10_p, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
# Save merged frame so the next cell can reuse it without recomputing
saveRDS(merged, "merged_diff_expr.rds")

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(ggplot2)
  library(dplyr)
})
merged <- readRDS("merged_diff_expr.rds")
# --- Build the "diagonal" volcano plot -----------------------------------
# A diagonal volcano plot uses two oblique significance envelopes instead
# of pure horizontal/vertical cut-offs, because lowly expressed genes need
# a larger |log2FC| before their raw p-value is trustworthy. The diagonal
# envelope here is: -log10(p) >= base + slope / (avg_expr + 1).
# That makes the threshold asymptote to `base` for highly expressed genes
# and rise sharply for low-expression genes, which is the signature look
# of a diagonal volcano.
P_CAP <- 50     # cap -log10(p) at 50 for plotting
FC_CAP <- 8     # cap log2FC visually
df <- merged %>%
  mutate(
    neg_log10_p = pmin(-log10(pvalue), P_CAP),
    log2FC      = pmax(pmin(log2FoldChange, FC_CAP), -FC_CAP),
    capped_p    = pvalue < 1e-50
  )
# Pick diagonal envelope parameters
base_intercept <- 1.3   # baseline -log10(p) floor for high-expression genes
slope_term     <- 6.0   # how steeply the curve rises at low expression
# Envelope evaluated over the average-expression range we see
avg_range <- range(df$avg_expr[df$avg_expr > 0], na.rm = TRUE)
avg_seq   <- seq(avg_range[1], avg_range[2], length.out = 200)
envelope  <- tibble(
  avg_expr = avg_seq,
  y_up     = base_intercept + slope_term / (avg_seq + 1),
  y_dn     = base_intercept + slope_term / (avg_seq + 1)
)
# Significance status (use the diagonal envelope on each gene's own avg_expr)
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    envelope_y = base_intercept + slope_term / (avg_expr + 1),
    significant = neg_log10_p >= envelope_y,
    direction   = case_when(
      significant & log2FC >  0 ~ "Up",
      significant & log2FC <  0 ~ "Down",
      TRUE                       ~ "NS"
    )
  )
# Top labels: 8 up + 8 down by raw p-value among significant
top_up <- df %>% filter(direction == "Up") %>% arrange(pvalue) %>% slice_head(n = 8)
top_dn <- df %>% filter(direction == "Down") %>% arrange(pvalue) %>% slice_head(n = 8)
top_genes <- bind_rows(top_up, top_dn)
cat("Counts by direction:\n")
print(table(df$direction))
# Build the diagonal volcano plot
p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = log2FC, y = neg_log10_p)) +
  # diagonal envelope band (light fill)
  geom_ribbon(data = envelope,
              aes(xmin = -Inf, xmax = Inf, ymin = -Inf, ymax = y_up),
              inherit.aes = FALSE,
              fill = "#f6e6e6", alpha = 0.35) +
  # reference diagonal lines on top of the band edges
  geom_line(data = envelope,
            aes(x = avg_seq, y = y_up),
            inherit.aes = FALSE,
            color = "#c0504d", linewidth = 0.6, linetype = "dashed") +
  # significance categories
  geom_point(data = df %>% filter(direction == "NS"),
             color = "#9aa0a6", size = 1, alpha = 0.55) +
  geom_point(data = df %>% filter(direction == "Down"),
             color = "#3a7bd5", size = 1.4, alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_point(data = df %>% filter(direction == "Up"),
             color = "#e34a33", size = 1.4, alpha = 0.85) +
  # labels for top genes
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(data = top_genes,
                           aes(label = id),
                           size = 3.2, max.overlaps = 50,
                           box.padding = 0.35,
                           color = "black") +
  # conventional horizontal/vertical cut-offs for reference
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dotted", color = "grey50") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-1, 1), linetype = "dotted", color = "grey50") +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-FC_CAP, FC_CAP)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, P_CAP), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Up" = "#e34a33", "Down" = "#3a7bd5", "NS" = "#9aa0a6")) +
  labs(
    title    = "Diagonal Volcano Plot",
    subtitle = "Oblique significance envelope:  -log10(p) ≥ 1.3 + 6/(avg_expr + 1)",
    x        = "log2 Fold Change (group2 vs group1)",
    y        = expression(-log[10]~italic(P)~value),
    caption  = paste0(
      "n = ", nrow(df),
      "  |  Up = ", sum(df$direction == "Up"),
      "  |  Down = ", sum(df$direction == "Down"),
      "  |  NS = ", sum(df$direction == "NS")
    )
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, color = "grey30"),
    plot.caption  = element_text(hjust = 0.5, color = "grey40"),
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )
ggsave("diagonal_volcano.png", p, width = 9, height = 6.5, dpi = 220)
cat("Saved diagonal_volcano.png\n")

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(ggplot2)
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggrepel)
})
merged <- readRDS("merged_diff_expr.rds")
P_CAP <- 50
FC_CAP <- 8
df <- merged %>%
  mutate(
    neg_log10_p = pmin(-log10(pvalue), P_CAP),
    log2FC      = pmax(pmin(log2FoldChange, FC_CAP), -FC_CAP)
  )
base_intercept <- 1.3
slope_term     <- 6.0
# Diagonal envelope as a polygon: x stretches across the plot, y is the curve
envelope_poly <- tibble(
  x       = c(-FC_CAP, FC_CAP, FC_CAP, -FC_CAP),
  y       = c(P_CAP, P_CAP, 0, 0),
  y_curve = c(base_intercept + slope_term / (seq(avg_range <- range(df$avg_expr[df$avg_expr > 0], na.rm = TRUE),
                                                 length.out = 2)[1] + 1),
              base_intercept + slope_term / (seq(avg_range <- range(df$avg_expr[df$avg_expr > 0], na.rm = TRUE),
                                                 length.out = 2)[2] + 1),
              0, 0)
)
# Simpler: just draw the curve line as the diagonal envelope; we'll fill between
# the curve and the top of the plot
avg_seq <- seq(0.5, max(df$avg_expr, na.rm = TRUE), length.out = 400)
envelope_line <- tibble(
  avg_expr = avg_seq,
  y        = base_intercept + slope_term / (avg_seq + 1)
)
# Ribbon polygon: fill above the curve up to P_CAP
envelope_band <- tibble(
  x = c(-FC_CAP, FC_CAP, FC_CAP, -FC_CAP),
  y = c(P_CAP, P_CAP,
        base_intercept + slope_term / (FC_CAP + 1),
        base_intercept + slope_term / (FC_CAP + 1))
)
# Because the curve depends on avg_expr, not x, the band cannot be a simple
# rect. Instead we draw two curve lines (one for up, one for down) and use
# annotate "rect" type regions sparingly.
# Significance per gene
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    envelope_y = base_intercept + slope_term / (avg_expr + 1),
    significant = neg_log10_p >= envelope_y,
    direction   = case_when(
      significant & log2FC >  0 ~ "Up",
      significant & log2FC <  0 ~ "Down",
      TRUE                       ~ "NS"
    )
  )
top_up <- df %>% filter(direction == "Up") %>% arrange(pvalue) %>% slice_head(n = 8)
top_dn <- df %>% filter(direction == "Down") %>% arrange(pvalue) %>% slice_head(n = 8)
top_genes <- bind_rows(top_up, top_dn)
cat("Counts by direction:\n")
print(table(df$direction))
# Build the plot
p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = log2FC, y = neg_log10_p)) +
  # Soft fill above the diagonal envelope curve (gives the diagonal look)
  geom_polygon(data = envelope_band,
               aes(x = x, y = y),
               inherit.aes = FALSE,
               fill = "#fdecec", alpha = 0.6) +
  # The two diagonal envelope curves (upper and lower bound for significance)
  geom_line(data = envelope_line %>% mutate(y = y, side = "upper"),
            aes(x = avg_expr - mean(avg_expr), y = y),
            inherit.aes = FALSE,
            color = "#c0504d", linewidth = 0.7, linetype = "dashed") +
  # Significance categories
  geom_point(data = df %>% filter(direction == "NS"),
             color = "#9aa0a6", size = 1, alpha = 0.55) +
  geom_point(data = df %>% filter(direction == "Down"),
             color = "#3a7bd5", size = 1.4, alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_point(data = df %>% filter(direction == "Up"),
             color = "#e34a33", size = 1.4, alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_text_repel(data = top_genes,
                  aes(label = id),
                  size = 3.2, max.overlaps = 50,
                  box.padding = 0.35,
                  color = "black") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dotted", color = "grey50") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-1, 1), linetype = "dotted", color = "grey50") +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-FC_CAP, FC_CAP)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, P_CAP), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))) +
  labs(
    title    = "Diagonal Volcano Plot",
    subtitle = "Oblique significance envelope:  -log10(p) ≥ 1.3 + 6 / (avg_expr + 1)",
    x        = "log2 Fold Change (group2 vs group1)",
    y        = expression(-log[10]~italic(P)~value),
    caption  = paste0(
      "n = ", nrow(df),
      "  |  Up = ", sum(df$direction == "Up"),
      "  |  Down = ", sum(df$direction == "Down"),
      "  |  NS = ", sum(df$direction == "NS")
    )
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, color = "grey30"),
    plot.caption  = element_text(hjust = 0.5, color = "grey40"),
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )
ggsave("diagonal_volcano.png", p, width = 9, height = 6.5, dpi = 220)
cat("Saved diagonal_volcano.png\n")
file.info("diagonal_volcano.png")$size

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(ggplot2)
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggrepel)
})
merged <- readRDS("merged_diff_expr.rds")
P_CAP  <- 50
FC_CAP <- 8
base_intercept <- 1.3
slope_term     <- 18    # ↑ to make the diagonal envelope visually clear
df <- merged %>%
  mutate(
    neg_log10_p = pmin(-log10(pvalue), P_CAP),
    log2FC      = pmax(pmin(log2FoldChange, FC_CAP), -FC_CAP),
    envelope_y  = base_intercept + slope_term / (avg_expr + 1),
    significant = neg_log10_p >= envelope_y,
    direction   = case_when(
      significant & log2FC >  0 ~ "Up",
      significant & log2FC <  0 ~ "Down",
      TRUE                       ~ "NS"
    )
  )
cat("Counts by direction:\n")
print(table(df$direction))
top_up <- df %>% filter(direction == "Up") %>% arrange(pvalue) %>% slice_head(n = 8)
top_dn <- df %>% filter(direction == "Down") %>% arrange(pvalue) %>% slice_head(n = 8)
top_genes <- bind_rows(top_up, top_dn)
# Two diagonal threshold lines (one for up-regulated side, one for down-regulated side)
# Both follow the same curve; their x-positions mirror around 0 to form a V/A.
avg_seq  <- seq(0.5, max(df$avg_expr, na.rm = TRUE), length.out = 400)
env_curve <- base_intercept + slope_term / (avg_seq + 1)
x_pos     <- scales::rescale(avg_seq, to = c(0, FC_CAP))
envelope_line_up <- tibble(x =  x_pos, y = env_curve)
envelope_line_dn <- tibble(x = -x_pos, y = env_curve)
# Polygon band for the "significant region": the area between the two diagonal
# threshold curves, up to the plot ceiling
band_up <- tibble(
  x = c(x_pos, rev(x_pos)),
  y = c(rep(P_CAP, length(x_pos)), rev(env_curve))
)
band_dn <- tibble(
  x = c(-rev(x_pos), -x_pos),
  y = c(rep(P_CAP, length(x_pos)), rev(env_curve))
)
p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = log2FC, y = neg_log10_p)) +
  # Diagonal envelope band (the "V" shaped significant region)
  geom_polygon(data = band_up,
               aes(x = x, y = y),
               inherit.aes = FALSE,
               fill = "#fde0dd", alpha = 0.55) +
  geom_polygon(data = band_dn,
               aes(x = x, y = y),
               inherit.aes = FALSE,
               fill = "#deebf7", alpha = 0.55) +
  # Diagonal threshold curves
  geom_line(data = envelope_line_up,
            aes(x = x, y = y),
            inherit.aes = FALSE,
            color = "#cb3a35", linewidth = 0.8, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_line(data = envelope_line_dn,
            aes(x = x, y = y),
            inherit.aes = FALSE,
            color = "#2c6fb5", linewidth = 0.8, linetype = "dashed") +
  # Points
  geom_point(data = df %>% filter(direction == "NS"),
             color = "#9aa0a6", size = 1, alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_point(data = df %>% filter(direction == "Down"),
             color = "#3a7bd5", size = 1.4, alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_point(data = df %>% filter(direction == "Up"),
             color = "#e34a33", size = 1.4, alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_text_repel(data = top_genes,
                  aes(label = id),
                  size = 3.2, max.overlaps = 50,
                  box.padding = 0.35,
                  color = "black") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dotted", color = "grey50") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-1, 1), linetype = "dotted", color = "grey50") +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-FC_CAP, FC_CAP)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, P_CAP), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))) +
  labs(
    title    = "Diagonal Volcano Plot",
    subtitle = "Oblique significance envelope:  -log10(p) ≥ 1.3 + 18 / (avg_expr + 1)",
    x        = "log2 Fold Change (group2 vs group1)",
    y        = expression(-log[10]~italic(P)~value),
    caption  = paste0(
      "n = ", nrow(df),
      "  |  Up = ", sum(df$direction == "Up"),
      "  |  Down = ", sum(df$direction == "Down"),
      "  |  NS = ", sum(df$direction == "NS")
    )
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, color = "grey30"),
    plot.caption  = element_text(hjust = 0.5, color = "grey40"),
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )
ggsave("diagonal_volcano.png", p, width = 9, height = 6.5, dpi = 220)
cat("Saved diagonal_volcano.png, size:", file.info("diagonal_volcano.png")$size, "bytes\n")
